[EN] (Guild) Order to Subjugate the Blightroar
[ES] (Gremio) Orden para subyugar el Blightroar
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Continuous subjugation always brings peace.
[ES] La subyugación continua siempre trae la paz.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you for your hard work.
[ES] Gracias por tu arduo trabajo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Token of Subjugating the Blightroar
[ES] Ficha de subyugación del Blightroar
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@Creature:47#3001#contaminated wendigos}, {@Creature:47#3002#argonomorph wendigos}, and {@Creature:47#3003#argonomorph wendigo shamans} around {@Rgn:47004$$Blightroar} and collect tokens.
[ES] Mata a {@Creature:47#3001#contaminated wendigos}, {@Creature:47#3002#argonomorph wendigos} y {@Creature:47#3003#argonomorph wendigo shamans} alrededor de {@Rgn:47004$$Blightroar} y recoge fichas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Laetesha at Pathfinder Post when mission is complete.
[ES] Informa a Laetesha en Pathfinder Post cuando la misión esté completa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
